gates.missing_scheduled_days: retain in denominator and fail completeness gate
gates.market_log_loss_gain: must be positive on exact matched verified market distributions
gates.positive_after_cost_edge: required with ask, spread, fees, depth, frozen fill assumptions and official resolution
gates.release: separate explicit approval required after all gates; never automatic

notes: These new thresholds do not change any existing Analog or production gate.
Thirty days is only a duration floor, not sufficient calibration evidence.
No candidate is admitted to this OOS protocol by this draft.
No meaningful confidence statement can be inferred from tiny reliability bins.
Revised formulas or newly selected candidates require a new version and fresh prospective cohort.
